summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Kate Bronfenbrenner, who is listed as Director of Labor Education Research at the Cornell University School of Industrial and Labor Relations. It describes her as a leading authority on successful labor union organizing strategies and on how outsourcing and offshoring affect workers and worker rights. The note gives her birth date as March 23, 1954 and contains no further details.
one_line: Kate Bronfenbrenner is a Cornell labor researcher and authority on union organizing and the effects of outsourcing on workers.
key_facts: Kate Bronfenbrenner was born on March 23, 1954.
Kate Bronfenbrenner is the Director of Labor Education Research at the Cornell University School of Industrial and Labor Relations.
Kate Bronfenbrenner is described as a leading authority on successful strategies in labor union organizing.
Kate Bronfenbrenner is described as a leading authority on the effects of outsourcing and offshoring on workers.
Kate Bronfenbrenner is described as a leading authority on worker rights in the context of outsourcing and offshoring.
